item.title: Morioka Reimen: Chewy Korean-Style Cold Noodles — Guide
item.description: Morioka reimen traces its roots to the city’s Zainichi Korean community — chewy, transparent noodles served in a chilled beef broth, topped with kimchi, a slice of fruit (often watermelon or apple) and a boiled egg. Refreshing and springy, it’s one of Morioka’s famous ‘three noodles’ and a summer favourite served year-round. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Morioka, Iwate Hours Restaurant hours Admission ~¥900–1,200 a bowl Time needed About 45 min Best time Summer; year-round What to Try Chewy, transparent cold noodles in beef broth.
